style_of_acupuncture.description: The style of acupuncture used (e.g., Traditional Chinese Medicine, Japanese, Korean, Western medical, Five Element, ear acupuncture, etc.).

reasoning_for_treatment.description: The reasoning for treatment provided, based on historical context, literature sources and/or consensus methods, with references where appropriate.

extent_treatment_varied.description: The extent to which treatment was varied.

num_needle_insertions.description: The number of needle insertions per subject per session (mean and range where relevant).

names_of_points.description: The names (or location if no standard name) of points used (uni-/bilateral).

depth_of_insertion.description: The depth of insertion, based on a specified unit of measurement or on a particular tissue level.

responses_sought.description: The responses sought (e.g. de qi or muscle twitch response).

needle_stimulation.description: The needle stimulation (e.g., manual or electrical).

frequency_treatment_sessions.description: The frequency and duration of treatment sessions.

other_intervention_details.description: The details of other interventions administered to the acupuncture group (e.g., moxibustion, cupping, herbs, exercises, lifestyle advice.

treatment_setting.description: The setting and context of treatment, including instructions to practitioners, and information and explanations to patients.
